descriptions.job-16jrc7k:
About the Company

Luxor is a full-stack platform for the Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure industries. We build software, hardware, financial, and energy solutions that help mining operators improve performance, manage risk, optimize costs, and scale their operations.

Location: Miami, FL or San Francisco, CA, in office. Our Miami office opens in Q1 2027; until then, Miami-based hires work remotely with regular customer travel.
Start: Immediately
Reports to: SVP, Business Development

About the Role

This posting is always open: we hire strong hunters whenever we meet them.

Luxor's sales team is organized into specialist pods:

  • Hardware & Logistics: ASIC procurement, brokerage and global logistics.

  • Hashrate Derivatives: hashprice hedges, fixed payouts and financing.

  • Mining Pool & Firmware: institutional Bitcoin mining pool and LuxOS firmware.

  • Energy & Commander: power supply and demand response in ERCOT and SPP, plus fleet management software.

You'll join the pod that best fits your background, interest and where the opportunity is biggest. You'll be trained across the full stack and expected to cross-sell where possible.

This is a closing role, not a meeting-booking role. You'll own your pipeline from first outreach to signed contract.

What you'll do

  • Prospect and close new business with mining operators, hosting providers, institutional clients and hardware counterparties.

  • Run the full cycle: outreach, discovery, proposals, negotiation, close and handoff to onboarding.

  • Grow your accounts across Luxor's product lines.

  • Spend most of your week in front of customers: on the phone, at their sites and at industry events.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate so your pipeline speaks for itself.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years in B2B sales, business development or another revenue-generating role, with deals you sourced and closed yourself.

  • Comfort with outbound: cold calls, cold emails, working a room at a conference.

  • Genuine interest in Bitcoin mining. You don't need to be an expert, but you should already know what a mining pool does and what an ASIC is, and be eager to go deep fast.

  • Ability to learn technical products and explain them in business terms.

  • Willingness to work in office in Miami or SF and travel for customers and events.

  • Spanish or Mandarin is a plus.

This role is for you if

  • You're competitive, self-directed and motivated by uncapped upside.

  • You want to learn an entire industry fast, with a sales team and onboarding program built to ramp you.

This role is not for you if

  • You want a structured SDR role with a manager running your day.

What we offer

  • Competitive base plus uncapped, gross-profit-based commission.

  • Direct exposure to the biggest operators in Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure.

  • A path to owning a pod as Luxor grows.

  • Health, dental and vision, 401(k) matching and unlimited PTO.

At Luxor we believe that meaningful contributions can be made by anyone. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Luxor welcomes all!

How we use AI in our hiring process

We use AI tools to support certain parts of our hiring process, and we believe in being transparent about how they’re used.

During your application, AI may assist in reviewing CVs, qualifications, and assignments by providing additional insights, but it does not make decisions, every application is evaluated at each step by a member of our hiring team.

We also use AI to transcribe interviews so our team can stay focused on the conversation rather than note-taking. Any voice recordings are automatically deleted within 15 days.

In addition, AI helps us keep candidates informed about their application status and helps us understand how our process is working so we can improve it over time.

In all cases, AI is used to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. If you have any questions about how we use these tools or your data, or if you would prefer to opt out of any of these features, please include them in the dedicated section of the application form, and we’ll follow up accordingly.
descriptions.job-1ggzccw:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

At Bitpanda we are redefining how Europe invests, and we want to speak to our customers in their own language, starting with German. You will own our German copy for CRM, product launches, website and landing pages: write natively in German first, adapt into English, and set the editorial standard every other market builds on. Our product marketing teams work in English; you turn their launch messaging into German that sounds like Bitpanda, fast. As part of Growth Operations you work closely with CRM, the product marketing managers, Localisation and Legal.

What you'll do

  • German-first copywriting: Write German copy for CRM (email, push, in-app), product launches, websites and landing pages, then produce the English reference version for other markets, with long-form content on request.
  • Editorial ownership: Have final say on wording, structure and clarity in both languages, while channel and campaign owners review message, facts and call to action.
  • Financial product communication: Explain crypto, stocks, ETFs and other investment products accurately, accessibly and compliantly, partnering with Legal and Compliance on financial claims and regulated wording.
  • Standards and tools: Build and maintain the German style guide, glossary and terminology, and shape the prompts and AI tools used in content and localisation.
  • Workflow and delivery: Take briefs from CRM, product marketing and channel owners, manage a steady flow of requests at speed without losing quality, and hand approved content into the localisation workflow.

Who you are

  • Languages: Native-level German that is idiomatic, precise and culturally current, plus business-fluent English strong enough to write the English version yourself.
  • Experience and portfolio: Four or more years as a content editor, copywriter or managing editor at a tech, fintech, media or consumer brand, ideally covering CRM and web, with a portfolio of CRM journeys, landing pages, articles or guides showing structure, clarity and a consistent voice.
  • Editorial rigour: A sharp eye for accuracy and consistency, and experience building or maintaining style guides and glossaries.
  • AI tools: Hands-on experience with AI writing tools and an appetite for shaping how we use them.
  • Finance knowledge (strong plus): Familiarity with investing, crypto or modern finance, and experience writing in a regulated industry.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).
descriptions.job-1214i4w:
About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

What we're looking for

Rain is looking for a Sales Engineer, in this role, you’ll work closely with our business development team, and our engineering team to help prospects deeply understand Rain’s capabilities, scope technical fit, and move quickly from interest to deployment.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role that blends product knowledge, customer empathy, and communication skills. You’ll be a critical bridge between our customers and our technical roadmap, and will shape how we scale sales engineering as Rain grows.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Business Development team to lead product demos, build proof-of-concepts, and answer in-depth technical and operational questions from prospects.

  • Serve as the product and infrastructure expert in sales conversations

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to provide structured customer feedback and influence roadmap decisions.

  • Work directly with prospective customers to model integrations

  • Create technical content and resources to enable our Business Development and Customer Support teams, including solution diagrams, data architecture docs, and integration walkthroughs.

What you will bring to Rain

  • 3+ years as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, or Implementation Specialist at a fast-growing SaaS company.

  • You’re comfortable explaining complex products to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • You love working directly with customers and solving real business problems through software.

  • You have experience integrating with financial systems

  • You thrive in early-stage environments where you can build processes from scratch.

Desirable but not mandatory

  • Experience with Enterprise Sales

  • Experience working in fintech or with financial data pipelines.

  • Familiarity with CRMs like Hubspot.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Flexible time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.
descriptions.job-0uafwwg:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the Growth Intelligence team and lead the development and delivery of high-impact growth projects across SEO, ASO, Learn, Copy, and Translation.
This role will act as the central Product Manager across these functions, transforming business requirements into clear product solutions, aligning stakeholders, working directly with engineers, and ensuring projects are delivered with measurable business impact.
Fluency in both Mandarin and English is a mandatory requirement.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Business Analysis

  • Conduct detailed business analysis across SEO, ASO, Learn, Copy, and Translation initiatives.
  • Assess business problems, user needs, operational gaps, and growth opportunities.
  • Review and challenge MRDs and business requests to ensure they are supported by clear data, business value, and measurable outcomes.
  • Translate approved business requirements into structured product strategies and execution plans.
  • Prioritize projects based on expected impact, urgency, resource requirements, and strategic alignment.

MRD and PRD Ownership

  • Lead the creation, assessment, and refinement of Market Requirements Documents and Product Requirements Documents.
  • Convert business requirements into clear product features, workflows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, risks, and potential implementation challenges before development begins.
  • Ensure every project has a clearly defined problem statement, target users, success metrics, scope, and expected business outcome.
  • Maintain product documentation throughout the full project lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Project Delivery

  • Serve as the central Product Manager for projects involving SEO, ASO, Learn, Copy, and Translation.
  • Work directly with engineering, data, design, operations, marketing, and business teams to move projects from concept to launch.
  • Manage project priorities, timelines, dependencies, blockers, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Help accelerate project delivery by ensuring engineers receive complete, validated, and actionable requirements.
  • Coordinate across multiple teams and ensure clear ownership throughout execution.
  • Support product testing, launch readiness, rollout planning, and post-launch optimization.

Measurement and Resource Allocation

  • Define clear success metrics and measurement frameworks for every project.
  • Measure project performance against adoption, efficiency, conversion, revenue, cost reduction, productivity, and other relevant growth indicators.
  • Conduct post-launch analysis to determine whether projects delivered the expected business impact.
  • Identify underperforming projects and recommend corrective actions, scope changes, or resource reallocation.
  • Provide data-backed recommendations on where engineering and operational resources should be invested.
  • Build clear reporting for leadership covering project performance, impact, risks, and next priorities.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in both Mandarin and English is mandatory.
  • Proven experience as a Product Manager within a Growth Product, Growth Technology, Growth Platform, or Growth Intelligence team.
  • Strong experience developing, reviewing, and managing MRDs and PRDs.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into scalable product and technical solutions.
  • Experience working directly with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Strong business analysis, data interpretation, prioritization, and project management capabilities.
  • Experience defining product success metrics and measuring post-launch performance.
  • Ability to manage multiple cross-functional projects simultaneously.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, highly cross-functional environment.

Preferred Experience

Experience in three or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:
  • SEO platforms, content discovery, technical SEO, or search performance.
  • ASO, mobile acquisition, app-store conversion, or app growth.
  • Learning platforms, educational content, or content-led user acquisition.
  • Copywriting operations, content management systems, or AI-assisted content production.
  • Translation, localization, language technology, or AI-powered translation workflows.
  • Growth analytics, attribution, experimentation, automation, or intelligence platforms.
  • AI-enabled operational workflows and productivity tools.

Core Competencies

  • Product ownership
  • Business analysis
  • MRD and PRD development
  • Growth product strategy
  • Data-driven prioritization
  • Engineering collaboration
  • Cross-functional project management
  • Success measurement and experimentation
  • Resource allocation
  • Stakeholder management
  • Mandarin and English communication

Success in This Role

The successful candidate will:
  • Establish a structured product development process across Growth Intelligence projects.
  • Improve the quality and clarity of MRDs and PRDs before engineering development begins.
  • Reduce project delays caused by incomplete requirements, unclear ownership, or cross-team dependencies.
  • Accelerate the delivery of projects across SEO, ASO, Learn, Copy, and Translation.
  • Ensure every project is connected to measurable growth, efficiency, revenue, or cost-saving outcomes.
  • Provide leadership with clear recommendations on project prioritization and resource allocation.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
descriptions.job-0ziwdu8:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Startups team is dedicated to winning the most valuable and promising startups in APAC. We achieve this by combining subject matter expertise with robust collaboration within the startup ecosystem. Our focus is on identifying and partnering with high-potential startups, assisting them in monetizing their products, scaling globally, and creating new revenue streams. 

By bringing the next generation of high-potential users to Stripe, we aim to support Stripe’s mission to to increase the GDP of the internet while fostering sustainable growth.

What you'll do

In this role you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing founders of funded startups in your region by helping them to understand how Stripe’s financial infrastructure and solutions can support their growth ambitions and create a competitive advantage for their businesses.

As an Account Executive on the Startups team, you’ll identify new opportunities for our clients to get the most out of Stripe’s growing products suite by thoroughly understanding our clients’ needs and advising them on how to leverage market-leading financial solutions to their own advantage. You will create and drive campaigns to build new sales pipeline and work with our users on increasing their Stripe adoption.

Responsibilities

  • Identify high-potential prospective startups and use effective prospecting strategies to generate leads that drive net-new revenue growth in your territory
  • Develop and implement scaled sales strategies for acquiring new customers and driving adoption of Stripe products across new accounts
  • Identify and understand users' pain points to propose Stripe solutions and own the full sales cycle, from business case development to close
  • Work cross-functionally to solve user pain points and improve our product to better serve new customer needs
  • Attend startup events across Southeast Asia
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process, including engaging with accelerators and VC firms
  • Engage with Product, Marketing, and User Operations teams to help amplify our growth trajectory

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of sales or client-facing experience, preferably at a high-growth SaaS company, bank, consultancy, or venture capital firm, with a track record of top performance
  • Track record of overachieving against ambitious sales targets
  • Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and build great relationships with technical customers
  • Analytical ability to manage complex sales cycles
  • Expertise in building territory plans to identify high payoff activities and initiatives in your market
  • Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment

Preferred requirements

  • Prior experience in payments
  • Prior experience in the startup ecosystem, either as founder or operator in a fast-scaling company
  • Interest in business models and monetization
descriptions.job-05in4nk:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopify, Lightspeed and Mindbody.

As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will navigate complex organizations and identify ways Stripe can exceed expectations. We’re building something new, developing our sales process, our value proposition and assisting in the creation of key tools and assets, we’re looking for pioneers to join us on this adventure. 

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do

As a Platform Account Executive for Japan, you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.

You will navigate complex organisations and identify ways Stripe can help them monetise financial services across their business. We’re early in building this specialisation with the need to develop our sales process, refine the value proposition and create a localised set of key tools and assets. We’re looking for pioneers to join us on this adventure! 

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for upper middle market and enterprise companies to showcase Stripe value in competitive processes, and consultatively apply highly-technical product knowledge from Stripe solutions.
  • Identify and engage with high-potential prospective SaaS Platforms, building long term, strategic relationships with them.
  • Work with leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) at existing and prospective users to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses
  • Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities within Japan
  • Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders at new and existing clients.

Who you are

You will operate independently, who has strong outbound and prospecting skills. You have strong B2B enterprise experience and have strong local market intelligence across Japan. You are an adept enterprise salesperson, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO.  You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies in Japan. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.

Minimum requirements

  • 5-7 years experience of directly selling a technology product or service to Japan, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance.
  • A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales. SaaS Platforms are trusting Stripe to help them monetise financial services, and you have demonstrated a consultative approach to sales, are quick to understand their potential monetisation strategy,  and are able to help your prospects articulate the value proposition of embedding financial services to create a SaaS Platform business unit.
  • Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies.
  • An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them. You are confident in understanding Stripe’s API and having technical discussion with support from Stripe engineers.
  • A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal.
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills in English is required for this role, as the role involves working with Japanese users and collaboration with global teams
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interest in technology and fintech.
  • Fastidious approach to CRM hygiene and experience utilizing thorough sales forecasting metrics on a weekly/quarterly basis and communicating them in a succinct manner.

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge and understanding of existing and developing payments technologies.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Senior Software Engineer, Tax Engineering

Tax Engineering sits at the intersection of every trade, every payment, and every product Coinbase ships. When a user buys Bitcoin, sells an equity, earns staking rewards, or redeems an Advisor-managed strategy, Tax Engineering is in the critical path, calculating cost basis, tracking gain/loss, determining withholding obligations, and producing compliance reporting across every product line and legal entity globally. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Tax team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build the extensible primitives that make each new Coinbase launch possible, where scale and accuracy are both non-negotiable.

What you'll do:

  • Own the design and delivery of backend systems for cost basis tracking, gain/loss calculation, withholding automation, and tax reporting infrastructure
  • Build new pipelines for broker reporting, automated withholding, and clearing integrations with partners as Coinbase expands into equities, margin, and options
  • Partner with Product, Design, Tax, Trading, and Positions teams to take ambiguous problems from scoping through production rollout
  • Drive an extensible tax architecture so every new product launch can plug into shared primitives without bespoke rework
  • Strengthen engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship across the team

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of backend software engineering experience building and operating production systems with high-quality, well-tested code
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, with experience designing high-throughput services and data pipelines where correctness is critical
  • Track record owning complex systems end-to-end, from design through production operation, in fast-changing domains
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional partners to translate ambiguous requirements into shipped solutions
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Who we are

What we learn from these relationships directly influences how Stripe builds its products. The opportunity in this region is massive. We’re tackling it as a diverse, international team that thrives on collaboration, bold innovation, and genuine curiosity. If you love to learn and want to make a meaningful impact, we'd love to have you join us.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead marketing strategy and plan execution for the DACH region and serve as the primary Marketing partner on the DACH Leadership Team. You’ll set the regional strategy and investment plan, with Germany as the main market, and shape priorities across Austria and Switzerland. You’ll be accountable for demand, pipeline, customer advocacy, and Stripe’s long-term market position in the region.

As a senior individual contributor, you will align regional and global cross-functional teams around shared priorities, secure the necessary resources, and navigate trade-offs between global strategies and local market needs. You will directly lead high-priority initiatives across the region.

Leveraging deep market and account insights, you will identify key growth opportunities across target industries and audiences. In close partnership with Sales, you will build tailored programs for strategic accounts and high-potential prospects aligned with their business models, technical environments, and commercial objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the integrated DACH marketing strategy, turning business goals, market dynamics, and competitive context into clear priorities.
  • Partner with DACH GTM leadership, Sales, Sales Development, and Partnerships to set shared priorities, join business and pipeline reviews, and focus investment on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Build and oversee a full-funnel DACH marketing plan across brand, demand generation, account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration, executive engagement, and customer advocacy.
  • Develop industry and account programs for strategic customers and high-potential prospects, helping Sales engage the right stakeholders with relevant messages.
  • Bring together EMEA and global teams, including Demand Generation and Product Marketing, to deliver the DACH plan, working with Sales, Product, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Communications.
  • Build Stripe’s brand and local presence in DACH through regional customer stories, partner programs, and executive, industry, and ecosystem engagement, including activation around Stripe flagship and third-party events.
  • Own metrics across demand, pipeline, opportunity progression, priority-account engagement, and return on investment. Use results to improve programs and stop or change those that aren’t delivering.
  • Represent DACH across EMEA and global marketing teams, bringing market insight into planning and sharing successful programs across markets.

Who you are

You’re an experienced B2B marketer who has owned a country, regional, or similarly broad marketing strategy. You can set direction, make investment trade-offs, and work credibly with senior Sales and GTM leaders. You stay close enough to execution to turn the strategy into commercial results.

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet them, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, including ownership of planning and investment for a country, region, or comparably broad portfolio in enterprise technology or another complex B2B environment.
  • Deep understanding of the German and wider DACH business and technology markets, including enterprise buying dynamics and local ecosystems.
  • Proven record of partnering with senior Sales and GTM leaders and aligning cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Experience leading integrated programs across several marketing disciplines, drawing on regional and global specialist teams.
  • Ownership of annual budgets and multi-program portfolios, with evidence of using commercial results to prioritize investment.
  • Fluency in German and English, with the ability to explain technical concepts and present complex strategies to executive audiences.
  • Sound judgment and comfort making decisions when priorities compete or information is incomplete.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in payments, financial technology, commerce, B2B cloud services, or another complex and highly competitive technology category.
  • Experience engaging enterprise executives and buying groups across Finance, Treasury, Technology, Product, and Operations.
  • A track record of building local brand relevance, thought leadership, customer advocacy, or influence strategies—not only demand-generation programs.
  • Experience building a marketing approach where the playbook, resources, or route to impact was still taking shape.

About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

Aspora moves money between the EU, the UK, the UAE and India. Every corridor runs on licences, partner banks and regulators who expect security to be proven, not promised. This role is the named local owner of ICT risk, information security and IT for our EU entity — the person responsible for making our security posture provable to any regulator, auditor or partner bank, on demand.

You will own the ICT risk framework, the regulatory relationship and the certification programme, working daily with Infrastructure, DevOps and the Head of Engineering, reporting to our COO. The role is built to grow into our senior security leadership seat.

Who You Are

— You've worked in regulated financial services. You've run information security or ICT risk inside a bank, EMI, payment institution or fintech, and you've sat across from the regulator during inspections or incident notifications.
— You've closed a certification cycle. You've owned or materially run ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI-DSS end to end — from scoping through evidence to closing the findings.
— You speak engineer. You can read AWS access controls and a vulnerability scan, triage what matters, and have a credible technical conversation with the people who fix it.
— You've led the response. You've run incident response and DR drills hands-on, made regulatory notification calls under pressure, and stayed accountable through the post-incident fix.
— You work in Lithuanian and English. You can represent the entity to the Bank of Lithuania and partner banks in both languages, in writing and in the room.
Most importantly, you want to own the whole picture: the framework, the regulator, the certification and the engineering follow-through, for a cross-border bank that is still being built.

What You'll Own

— ICT risk and regulatory assurance. Build and run the DORA risk framework, policies, risk register and third-party register. Represent the EU entity to the Bank of Lithuania, auditors and partner banks on every IT and security matter, and close findings before they age.
— Certifications. Run the group ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS programme for the EU entity so one body of evidence serves every jurisdiction.
— Incident response and data protection. Own the incident-response playbook including the regulatory notification path, run DR and BCP drills, and be the technical counterpart to the DPO on DPIAs, transfer assessments and breach notifications.
— Engineering follow-through. Convert audit and regulatory requirements into engineering tickets with owners and dates, and follow every one to closure.
— Entity IT. Own devices, identity and access, SaaS tooling and joiner/mover/leaver for EU staff.

Why Aspora

— Define what provable security looks like for a cross-border bank — and set the standard every future entity inherits.
— Work directly with our COO and Head of Engineering, with the authority to set the bar and the support to hold it.
— Own the EU entity's regulatory relationship on security from day one, with room to grow the function as Aspora grows.
— Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora's long-term vision.

Location

Vilnius, Lithuania

About Dune
https://dune.com/about

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers

About the role

Dune’s mission is to make onchain finance observable. Since 2018, we have made blockchain data accessible and useful. Our next opportunity is to build products that financial institutions depend on to commit capital, assess risk, and enter new onchain markets.

As these institutions expand their activity on blockchains, they will need reliable, trustworthy and timely data to power decision making across more markets than ever before. They will need to compare opportunities, monitor changes, and integrate data into their existing systems. For Dune these recurring needs will become a substantial and core part of our business.

We are looking for a Head of Product to help transition Dune into this new era. We will build on top of Dune’s existing data foundation, which already powers thousands of companies. You will decide which customers and use cases to serve first, which problems matter most, and which needs can become scalable products for institutional usage.

You will identify valuable customer problems and guide the company to deliver a reliable product and grow its usage.

You have led product as a Head of Product, VP or similar at a company relevant to Dune, such as data, developer platforms, crypto, fintech or a fast-growing startup. You learn new domains fast. Knowledge of traditional or onchain markets, and of how market participants use data, is a strong plus.

You can set a clear direction, make difficult choices, and work hard through the details required to deliver. The job’s not finished with a PRD, a hire or a ticket. The job’s finished when the product is creating value in the hands of our customers, being recursively improved by tight knit relationships.

You will work closely with Dune’s engineering, data, and commercial teams while being an integral part of the leadership team. You will report to the president. Your responsibility extends from understanding a customer’s problem to delivering a product that solves it, while navigating the requirements from a large customer base.

You should be equally comfortable discussing an institution’s data requirements and deciding what the team must deliver this week.

In this role you will

  • Define the product strategy for market data and institutional customers. Decide which customers, problems, and products deserve our attention.

  • Understand how financial institutions consume data. Turn their research, investment, trading, and operational needs into clear product priorities.

  • Define how we measure success of our products. Use the results to decide what to improve or stop.

  • Define and improve on our operational practices.

  • Leverage AI to improve our customer research, operations and feedback loops.

  • Lead and develop a product team that takes responsibility for customer results.

  • Say no and prioritize.

  • You're excited to spend real time with customers: on calls, in their offices, learning from them.

  • You have delivered technically complex data products that customers depend on.

  • Bonus: you understand market data and how financial institutions evaluate, buy, integrate and use it.

  • Bonus: you know onchain markets, tokenized equities and RWAs

  • You can connect customer needs with technical requirements and a sound business case.

  • You have strong product judgment. You can make decisions with incomplete information and change them when the evidence changes.

Perks & Benefits

About the Job

zerohash's Applied AI team manages two fronts: an internal Intelligence Core (a system connectivity and control layer) and external agentic-commerce products. This role acts as the engineering backbone for both—building the access layer, audit logging, skills/agents, and system architecture. The Applied AI team builds the Intelligence Core itself. Engineering maintains platform accounts, event hooks, and retrieval layers; this role builds everything above them.

Core objective: Connect company systems securely, and produce records of agent action that a third party can verify.

Strategic importance: The internal build acts as a sandbox for agentic commerce products. Identity, authority, write permissions, and tamper-evident logging will be proven internally before powering multi-institutional agentic networks.

Responsibilities

  • Own the access layer (native connectors, MCP servers, Databricks US/EU) using short-lived tokens, least-privilege read-only access, and zero raw PII while enforcing data residency.
  • Define a versioned schema for two signed record types of credentials and action records, in one namespace so each can be checked against the other.
  • Establish build discipline early: deployment pipelines, authority policy as code, skill merge gates, and signed builds with SBOMs.
  • Build the authority lease service with integrated kill switches.
  • Capture events into append-only, hash-chained logs for tamper-evident and independently verifiable auditing.
  • Migrate the team’s existing agents onto the Core, launch new per-department agents and lead security reviews for continuous read access.
  • Extend the Core from read to bounded write: logged actions, idempotency keys, compensating actions, and multi-approver time-locks for anything that moves money.
  • Design core primitives for cross-institution interoperability, wrapping actions in signed mandates, scoped authority, and attestation receipts compatible with standards like x402, AP2, and MPP.
  • Design self-hosted, zero-egress private stacks when required by classification evidence.
  • Evaluate and integrate state-of-the-art developments in agent frameworks, confidential inference, and zero-knowledge attestations.
  • Maintain a security-first posture by threat-modeling prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and confused-deputy risks upfront.

Requirements

  • Senior, Python-first backend engineering with production experience in event-driven systems, API integration, and CI/CD.
  • Agent-system experience — composing LLM agents (Claude, GPT, or comparable; Bedrock or comparable platforms) into standing systems — with the judgment to keep the models at the edges and the control plane deterministic.
  • Demonstrate security-first habits in a regulated environment (MSB/VASP, bank, or comparable): least privilege and read-only as reflexes, not requirements to be reminded of.
  • Working familiarity with capability-based authorization: attenuable tokens, workload identity, policy-as-code.

Preferred

  • Verifiable credentials, HTTP message signatures, or any of the emerging agent-payment mandate schemes (x402, AP2, MPP, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay).
  • Self-hosted LLM stacks; confidential computing / trusted execution environments.
  • A research habit and autonomy: this is a foundational seat on a new team, with wide scope and few hand-holds.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

About Mantle

We’re building an AI agent to help families support their aging parents (origin story here).

 

Over 40M “sandwich generation” Americans currently manage their parent’s affairs. Keeping mom/dad safe and supported is like a second job: it’s time-consuming, stressful and on top of their already busy lives. We believe that managing our parents’ affairs should feel under control, easier and lower stress.

 

Co-founded by serial entrepreneur partners including Ted Zagat, who sold his previous businesses to Slack (announcement here) and Google (Zagat restaurant guides).

The Role

We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own Mantle's paid acquisition. This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to build our paid engine from the ground up and find the channels, creative and messages that bring families to Mantle efficiently. You will work side-by-side with our founders and marketing team, and own the results.

This is a role for a builder. In the early days, paid acquisition is about fast, disciplined testing. It's not just about strategy; it's about the unglamorous work of launching campaigns, briefing and iterating on creative, checking tracking, and pulling budget from what isn't working before it costs us. You'll be the one doing the hands-on work today so we can scale what works tomorrow.

What You'll Build

  • Paid acquisition engine: Launch, manage and scale campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok and emerging channels.

  • Creative testing: Build a high-velocity system for developing, testing and learning from ad creative and messaging.

  • Measurement and attribution: Set up the tracking, attribution and reporting that tell us true cost and payback.

  • Budget management: Allocate spend with discipline and scale the channels that hit our targets.

  • Landing pages and funnels: Partner with product and design to improve conversion from click to member.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally at a consumer startup or high-growth company

  • Track record of profitably scaling paid social and paid search budgets

  • Deep experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, plus attribution and analytics tools

  • Strong creative instinct and experience running structured creative tests

  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort in spreadsheets and SQL

Ideal Background

  • Early-stage startup experience where you built paid acquisition from zero

  • Experience marketing a moderate-to-high consideration consumer product (e.g. a subscription or financial product)

  • Experience reaching busy adults in their 40s and 50s

  • Savvy using AI tools to accelerate creative production and analysis

  • Nice to have, but not required: experience with FinTech

Who Thrives Here

  • Builders: You love creating things from scratch and taking full ownership

  • Data-driven: You let results, not opinions, decide where the next dollar goes

  • Scrappy: You operate well without a lot of structure or resources and find ways to "get it done"

  • Founder-minded: You think like an owner and spend every dollar like it's your own

  • AI-forward: You embrace modern AI

  • Autonomous: You thrive with minimal direction

  • Mission-driven: You care about what we're building

What You'll Get

  • Meaningful work: Grow a consumer product that will make a real difference in the lives of millions of families, with fast pace and huge financial potential

  • Small team impact: Work directly with founders and see immediate impact from your work

  • Partnership with founders: Work closely with Mantle's co-founders and other company leaders

  • Learning & growth: Opportunity to build a category-defining company from the ground up

  • Real ownership: Your decisions will shape our product, business and culture

  • Remote Fridays: Work from home every Friday. Monday through Thursday, we build together in person in San Francisco
